# Prolewatch 0.12.4

`0.12.4` is an experimental patch release for x86-64 Arch Linux. Independent
auditing remains outstanding. Start evaluation on an isolated system.

- The package includes `prolewatch(1)` and `prolewatch-config(5)` manual pages.
  Package verification now recognizes the compressed paths produced by
  `makepkg`.
- The AUR metadata tells users to run `prolewatch setup` after installation.
- The AUR recipe downloads `prolewatch-0.12.4.tar.gz` and its detached
  signature from this release. It verifies the archive checksum and pins the
  maintainer fingerprint through `validpgpkeys`.

The public key is attached as `prolewatch-release-key.asc`. Its fingerprint is
`296E983E7120909958BD38E557F1F87148E02B27`. The key is also available from
public keyservers.

The Linux amd64 binaries, SBOMs and binary archive are verification artifacts.
The supported installation path is the
[`prolewatch`](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/prolewatch) AUR package.
